headline: DPD RI Chair Sultan Najamudin Clarifies Institutional Neutrality
seoTitle: DPD RI Chair Clarifies Institutional Neutrality
metaDescription: Sultan Najamudin states the DPD RI operates as a non-partisan regional representative body following recent support for a political figure.
aiSummaryBullets: Sultan Najamudin clarified that DPD RI functions as a regional representative body rather than a political party.
The chair stated that support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad from DPD members is personal and not representative of the institution.
DPD RI continues to focus on regional development, legislative oversight, and addressing local economic concerns.
aiContextParagraph: The Regional Representative Council of the Republic of Indonesia (DPD RI), led by Chair Sultan Najamudin, has recently emphasized its institutional role as a non-partisan entity representing regional interests. Following instances of DPD members expressing personal support for political figures such as Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, Sultan Najamudin clarified that such actions do not reflect an official organizational endorsement. The institution has been actively engaged in initiatives such as the 'Senator Menyapa' program and the 'DPD RI Awards,' which aim to strengthen public trust and encourage regional development. Furthermore, leadership has highlighted various policy objectives, including the promotion of 'Green Democracy' as an economic catalyst, the oversight of regional budgets, and the pursuit of legislative breakthroughs to ensure that natural resource wealth is effectively utilized for the benefit of local communities.
whyItIsViral: This story is circulating due to reporting from three independent media outlets following official clarifications regarding the institution's political stance.
